title: Quickly Melted Irish Cheese Quesadilla
description: A simple, comforting dish that combines the richness of Irish cheese with the crunch of terracotta-dried vegetables.
instructions: Place a terracotta-dish in a cold smoker for 2 hours to infuse the air with a smoky flavor.
Remove the terracotta-dish from the smoker and place it in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C).
Cook the dried carrots and onions in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a mixing bowl, combine the shredded Irish cheddar cheese, smoked paprika, cacao powder, and salt.
Place a tortilla in the preheated oven for 2 minutes on each side to warm it.
Brush the melted coconut oil on one side of the tortilla.
Place the tortilla, oil-side down, in the terracotta-dish and spoon the cheese mixture on top.
Top the cheese mixture with the cooked carrots and onions.
Place another tortilla on top of the filling and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
Carefully flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the other side is also crispy and golden brown.
Remove the quesadilla from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
